exercises.why: **составим** — соста́вить (perfective): to constitute, to make up, to form; to amount to, to sum up to; to compose, to construct, to draw up, to prepare; to place objects on top of each other to form a stack. Wiktionary: со- + ста́вить.

exercises.why: **доставлю** — доста́вить (perfective): to deliver, to convey, to supply, to furnish; to procure, to cause, to give; to give, to provide, to afford. Wiktionary: до- + ста́вить.

to constitute, to make up, to form
to deliver, to convey, to supply, to furnish
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ста́вить — to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station; соста́вить — to constitute, to make up, to form; доста́вить — to deliver, to convey, to supply, to furnish; наставле́ние — directions, instructions.
**наставления** — наставле́ние: directions, instructions; admonition, precept, exhortation; (military) manual. Wiktionary: наста́вить + -е́ние.
